gaps.hint: subject of the sentence: noun needed (-ness becomes -ty here)
gaps.explanation: The subject must be a noun: Honesty. The spelling changes -ness to -ty; 'honestness' is not a word.

gaps.sentence: This grant will ___ her to study abroad (ABLE).
gaps.hint: positive verb needed: make it possible (en-)
gaps.explanation: The prefix en- forms the verb: enable means to make able. 'Disable' is the negative opposite.

gaps.sentence: His ___ (CONFIDENT) was shaken by the failure.

gaps.explanation: The suffix -en forms verbs from adjectives: thicken. A base verb follows 'to'.
After 'complete' a noun is needed: darkness (-ness noun of 'dark').

gaps.sentence: The treaty will strengthen economic ___ between the two countries (COOPERATE).
gaps.explanation: An adjective is followed by a noun: cooperation (-tion noun).

gaps.sentence: Don't ___ your children — let them make their own mistakes (PROTECT).
gaps.hint: protect too much (over-); a base verb is needed
gaps.explanation: The prefix over- means excessively: overprotect means to protect too much. A base verb follows 'Don't'.
